packageRules.description: One PR for all non-major bumps — they're reviewed as a batch.
The Obsidian typings track the app, which ships often; keep them separate so a typing bump is never buried in a batch.
isomorphic-git backs the object store on both platforms — never batch it, and never take a same-week release.
The toolchain lives in two files — mise.toml (what you and CI install) and package.json's packageManager (what a pnpm run actually uses). Group them so they can never land half-updated.
Node's own versioning scheme treats non-LTS lines as unstable, so this keeps us on LTS instead of jumping to Current the week it ships.
